title: ChatSendMessage
description: Send a message to the room's text chat (since 1.11). Needs the text capability and canWriteChat. The room trims the text, keeps it at most 2,000 characters and limits how many messages a person sends per minute (rate_limited).

text.description: Plain text. Trimmed by the room; above 2,000 characters (code points) it answers chat_message_too_long.

clientId.description: Chosen by the sending tab to match its optimistic copy; echoed in the chat.message that answers it.
